title: National Math Camps - Camp Sierpinski
text:
Camp Sierpiński is a 2-week residential camp for students aged 11 – 14 located at William Peace University in Raleigh, NC. It's part of National Math Camps. At Camp Sierpiński, along with learning math, students discover a sense of belonging, develop resilience, and build a lifelong connection with the mathematical community. Participants to experience math as both fascinating and challenging, learning that it’s not just fun when it’s easy, but even more rewarding when you push through difficulties.

It remains fully need-blind with financial aid available up to 100 percent of tuition and travel.
